name: FDD or requirement to production
trigger: pipeline item, signed FDD or requirement

steps.name: Spec in
steps.means: A new FDD or requirement arrives; master tasks a sizing.

steps.name: Sizing
steps.means: The client agent sizes the work and gives an hours estimate.

steps.name: Approve estimate
steps.means: The board accepts a tight estimate on its own; a wide one waits for Ben. Status and dates stay his.
steps.gate: inside the estimate band (high/low <= estimate_max_ratio, high <= estimate_max_high h; switch auto_estimate) code accepts it; else Ben approves. Status and dates stay his

steps.name: Architect handoff
steps.means: The client agent lays out the design and build plan.

steps.name: Ben rules on the design
steps.means: Only if the design has open questions: Ben answers them before the build.
steps.gate: Ben rules on the handoff's open questions before the build

steps.name: Build and dev compile
steps.means: The client agent builds the code and dev-compiles it; nothing is checked in yet.
steps.gate: build and dev-compile only; do not check in

spec.read_first: coord_get_task_result {prev} (the step before this one in case {case}: {root_title}).
constraints: Build and dev-compile only; do not check in.
Return compile: "clean" only when the build and dev-compile ran with no errors or warnings.

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks the code against the CVC code checklist.

steps.name: Check-in approval
steps.means: The board approves the check-in on its own once the review passes, the files are unchanged and the compile is clean; otherwise Ben approves it.
steps.gate: checkin_auto: review approves, files unchanged, compile clean, veto window passed; else Ben approves the check-in

steps.name: Check-in
steps.means: The client agent checks the approved code into CVC.

steps.name: Pipeline note
steps.means: Master adds a note to the SharePoint pipeline item saying what landed.

steps.name: Test evidence
steps.means: The client agent puts together the test evidence.

steps.name: Promote DEVL/TEST/PROD
steps.means: Ben asks for the move to TEST and PROD; it is installed there.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 9 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: UAT sign-off
steps.means: The client signs off in UAT and Ben records it; that closes the case.
steps.gate: client signs off; Ben records it
